agent: the baseline agent with its defaults (straightpool.base_agent)

left_out.decision-rows.jsonl: every decision row of the games, written by the first command; the tests read only the trigger rows

made_with: a previous version of this package's code, before the baseline agent aimed its ball-in-hand strokes from the seat (straightpool/AGENT-CARD-base.md); the commands name this version's modules, and run with this version they may write other bytes
note: The bytes depend on the kernel build each game record names as a hash ('kernel') and on this package's code when they were made; another build or a later version of the code makes other games.
